    • getFileStoreOrganizations

      public List<FileStoreOrganization> getFileStoreOrganizations()
      Description copied from interface: FileStoreFactory
      The supported organizations for FileStore creation. Note that this isn't particularly useful for archives, so there is a generic "archive" organization. For disk images, this will typically orient around the physical device including sector ordering, if applicable.
      Specified by:
      getFileStoreOrganizations in interface FileStoreFactory
